Eligibility Rules

Eligibility is decided on the first day of the month following the qualifying event.

Who is eligible

Relationship Eligible Evidence required
Employee Yes None
Spouse or partner Yes Marriage or partnership certificate
Child under 26 Yes Birth certificate, or adoption papers
Other dependent Case by case See Appeals Process

What eligibility is not

Eligibility is not enrolment. An eligible person who misses the enrolment window waits for the next open period or a qualifying life event.

The rules above restate HR-114; where they differ, HR-114 governs.
